smt-2024-general-tiebreaker-01.title: Subtract pieces
smt-2024-general-tiebreaker-01.body:
$[ADC]=\frac12\cdot12\cdot10=60$. The part of $\triangle ADC$ not in $\triangle AMB$ consists of $\triangle ADM$ (area $\frac12\cdot12\cdot5=30$) and $\triangle CMN$, where $N=AC\cap BM$. Triangles $ABN$ and $CMN$ are similar with ratio $AB:CM=10:5=2$, so the height of $\triangle CMN$ from $N$ is $\frac13\cdot12=4$ and its area is $\frac12\cdot5\cdot4=10$. The overlap has area $60-30-10=20$.

**Answer: 20**

smt-2024-general-tiebreaker-02.title: Condition on days with a sprout
smt-2024-general-tiebreaker-02.body:
Look only at days on which at least one unsprouted beanstalk sprouts. With $3$ unsprouted, the chance that exactly one sprouts, given at least one sprouts, is $\frac{3\cdot\frac13\cdot(\frac23)^2}{1-(\frac23)^3}=\frac{4/9}{19/27}=\frac{12}{19}$. With $2$ unsprouted, the chance exactly one sprouts given at least one is $\frac{2\cdot\frac13\cdot\frac23}{1-(\frac23)^2}=\frac{4/9}{5/9}=\frac45$. Then the last one sprouts alone. Probability $\frac{12}{19}\cdot\frac45=\frac{48}{95}$.

**Answer: $\frac{48}{95}$**
